cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.42% · WTI -0.40% · Brent -1.07% · NatGas +1.44%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +6.09%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.09%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.85%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +18.68%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +18.68%, BE +9.36%, ENPH +8.74%, TLN +8.41%, GEV +6.63%. Laggards: MPLX -2.26%, FANG -1.99%, PEG -1.73%, APA -1.52%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
